messages:
ava: monitoring just fired for hosted-usw1 - pool-7 p95 queue=134s p99=320s. autoscaler did not add capacity. grafana snapshot: <https://grafana.redwood.net/d/pool-7?view=recent>

deploy-bot: DeployBot: Created alert #3456 - Hosted GPU Pool Saturation (pool-7) :rotating_light:

matt: @ava can you paste the capacity dashboard panel (admission, queue depth, fragmentation)? is this KV-cache missstorm or admission thrash?

ava: panel link above. quick note: admission rejects up, sustained queue deep. metrics looked like:
```
pool=pool-7 region=usw1 p95_queue_ms=134000 p99_queue_ms=320000 admission_reject_rate=18%
```

zoe: looking at admission-control logs, I see a lot of "reject -> retry" loops. fallback routing to smaller model variants not triggering for some customers (routing policy evals are OK). @leo can you check host-level fragmentation?

leo: checked ring health: fragmentation +22% over 6h. several hosts with only 1 slot free. eviction rate ~3/min. warmup jobs pinned on those hosts (image-warmup service). suspect warmup concurrency.

sam: if warmup is holding slots, quick mitigations: reduce warmup concurrency on pool-7, or preempt warmup containers; or lower per-request max_batch (12 -> 8) which reduces tail latency at cost of throughput.

nina: routing 10% of traffic to dedicated or eu region is possible but costy (egress + reserved price diff). rough estimate: +$120/hr if we spill ~200 RPS to dedicated endpoints. need approval from cost team.

ava: temporary actions taken: bumped pool admission floor (max_admit) -10% to cut long tail admits, triggered targeted drain of warmup jobs on 4 hosts, and forced a refill attempt. will monitor for next 15m.

zoe: ran inspect command:
```
$ rctl pool inspect pool-7 --region usw1 --short
utilization: 98%
fragmentation: 22%
hosts: 64 total, 8 with warmup pinned
host-23: slots 0/8 warmup: no
host-27: slots 1/8 warmup: yes
host-41: slots 0/8 warmup: yes
```

matt: opening incident tracker and assigning oncall: <https://incidents.redwood/3456> assigning @dana_oncall. dana, please confirm if we should enable cross-region spill for 5-10% traffic.

oncall-bot: Oncall-CLI: Incident 3456 created and assigned to dana_oncall. ETA 15m. :white_check_mark:

dana_oncall: looking now, pls hold any config rollouts to pool-7 until we get stable 30m window. I'll evaluate safe spill policies.

matt: will follow up with Cost for an ear-marked budget if we need to spill. also schedule a retro to reduce warmup concurrency defaults.

ava: thanks all — monitoring shows queue p95 down to ~72s after the changes (still high). keeping this thread updated.
